## Code

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    int largestRectangleArea(vector<int>& arr) {
        int ans=0;
        int n=arr.size();
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
            
            int left=i;
            int right=i;

            while(left>0 && arr[left-1]>=arr[i]){
                left--;
            }

            while (right < n-1 && arr[right+1] >= arr[i]){
                right++;
            }
            ans=max(ans, arr[i]*(right-left+1));
        }
            
        return ans;
    }
};
```
